notes: First external M3 calibration. Stockfish 19 is deliberately limited to its minimum UCI_Elo setting (1320) so the material-only reference engine has a measurable opponent. UCI_Elo is an engine strength-control parameter, not a claim about the candidate's human/FIDE rating. Stockfish is single-threaded with a 1 MiB hash; ponder and tablebases remain disabled by the M3 protocol/default configuration.
